title: OpenTelemetry

fields.name: add_label
fields.description: Adds a custom label to the metrics use format: add_label name value.

fields.name: alias
fields.description: Sets an alias, use for multiple instances of the same output plugin.

fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS SigV4 authentication

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API, can be used with the aws_role_arn parameter.

fields.name: aws_profile
fields.description: AWS Profile name. AWS Profiles can be configured with AWS CLI.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: AWS region of your service.

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume (ex. for cross account access).

fields.name: aws_service
fields.description: AWS destination service code, used by SigV4 authentication.

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Custom endpoint for the AWS STS API, used with the aws_role_arn option.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.description: Set the maximum number of log records to be flushed at a time.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. Options available are gzip and zstd.

fields.name: grpc
fields.description: Enable, disable or auto-detect gRPC usage. Accepted values: on, off, auto.

fields.name: grpc_logs_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional gRPC URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: grpc_metrics_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional gRPC URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: grpc_profiles_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional gRPC URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: grpc_traces_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional gRPC URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add a HTTP header key/value pair. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP server.

fields.name: http2
fields.description: Enable, disable or force HTTP/2 usage. Accepted values : on, off, or force.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Set HTTP auth password.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Set HTTP auth user.

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Specifies the log level for output plugin. If not set here, plugin uses global log level in service section.

fields.name: log_response_payload
fields.description: Specify if the response payload should be logged or not.

fields.name: log_suppress_interval
fields.description: Suppresses log messages from output plugin that appear similar within a specified time interval. 0 disables suppression.

fields.name: logs_attributes_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify an Attributes key.

fields.name: logs_body_key
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: logs_body_key_attributes
fields.description: If set and it matched a pattern, it includes the remaining fields in the record as attributes.

fields.name: logs_instrumentation_scope_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify an InstrumentationScope key.

fields.name: logs_max_resources
fields.description: Set the maximum number of OTLP log resources per export request (0 disables the limit).

fields.name: logs_max_scopes
fields.description: Set the maximum number of OTLP log scopes per resource (0 disables the limit)

fields.name: logs_metadata_key
fields.description: Set the key to look up in the metadata.

fields.name: logs_observed_timestamp_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify an ObservedTimestamp key..

fields.name: logs_resource_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a Resource key.

fields.name: logs_severity_number_message_key
fields.description: Specify a SeverityNumber key.

fields.name: logs_severity_number_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a SeverityNumber key.

fields.name: logs_severity_text_message_key
fields.description: Specify a SeverityText key

fields.name: logs_severity_text_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a SeverityText key.

fields.name: logs_span_id_message_key
fields.description: Specify a SpanId key.

fields.name: logs_span_id_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a SpanId key.

fields.name: logs_timestamp_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a Timestamp key.

fields.name: logs_trace_flags_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a TraceFlags key.

fields.name: logs_trace_id_message_key
fields.description: Specify a TraceId key.

fields.name: logs_trace_id_metadata_key
fields.description: Specify a TraceId key.

fields.name: logs_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: metrics_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time allowed to establish a connection, this time includes the TLS handshake.

fields.name: net.connect_timeout_log_error
fields.description: On connection timeout, specify if it should log an error. When disabled, the timeout is logged as a debug message.

fields.name: net.dns.mode
fields.description: Select the primary DNS connection type (TCP or UDP).

fields.name: net.dns.mode
fields.description: net.dns.prefer_ipv4

fields.name: net.dns.prefer_ipv6
fields.description: Prioritize IPv6 DNS results when trying to establish a connection.

fields.name: net.io_timeout
fields.description: Set maximum time a connection can stay idle while assigned.

fields.name: net.keepalive_max_recycle
fields.description: Set maximum number of times a keepalive connection can be used before it retries.

fields.name: net.max_worker_connections
fields.description: Set the maximum number of active TCP connections that can be used per worker thread.

fields.name: net.proxy_env_ignore
fields.description: Ignore the environment variables HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY when set.

fields.name: net.source_address
fields.description: Specify network address to bind for data traffic.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive
fields.description: Enable or disable Keepalive support.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_interval
fields.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes when no response is received on a keep idle probe.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_probes
fields.description: Number of unacknowledged probes to consider a connection dead.

fields.name: net.tcp_keepalive_time
fields.description: Interval between the last data packet sent and the first TCP keepalive probe.

fields.name: oauth2.audience
fields.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 audience parameter.

fields.name: oauth2.auth_method
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 client authentication method. Supported values: basic, post, private_key_jwt.

fields.name: oauth2.client_id
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID.

fields.name: oauth2.client_secret
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret.

fields.name: oauth2.connect_timeout
fields.description: Connect timeout for OAuth 2.0 token requests.

fields.name: oauth2.enable
fields.description: Enable OAuth 2.0 client credentials for outgoing requests

fields.name: oauth2.jwt_aud
fields.description: Audience for private_key_jwt JSON Web Token (JWT) assertion. Defaults to the value of oauth2.token_url when not set.

fields.name: oauth2.jwt_cert_file
fields.description: Path to certificate file used by private_key_jwt.

fields.name: oauth2.jwt_key_file
fields.description: Path to PEM private key file used by private_key_jwt.

fields.name: oauth2.jwt_key_file
fields.description: Path to PEM private key file used by private_key_jwt.

fields.name: oauth2.jwt_ttl_seconds
fields.description: Lifetime in seconds for private_key_jwt JWT client assertions.

fields.name: oauth2.refresh_skew_seconds
fields.description: Seconds before expiry at which to refresh the access token.

fields.name: oauth2.resource
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 resource parameter.

fields.name: oauth2.scope
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 scope.

fields.name: oauth2.timeout
fields.description: Timeout for OAuth 2.0 token requests.

fields.name: oauth2.token_url
fields.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint URL.

fields.name: oauth2.user_agent
fields.description: User-Agent header value to include in OAuth 2.0 token requests. If omitted, no User-Agent header is sent.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target server.

fields.name: profiles_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the profiles OTel endpoint.

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: Specify an HTTP Proxy. The expected format of this value is http://host:port.

fields.name: retry_limit
fields.description: Set retry limit for output plugin when delivery fails. Integer, no_limits, false, or off to disable, or no_retries to disable retries entirely

fields.name: TLS
fields.description: Enable or disable TLS/SSL support.

fields.name: tls.ca_file
fields.description: Absolute path to CA certificate file..

fields.name: tls.ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files.

fields.name: tls.crt_file
fields.description: Absolute path to Certificate file.

fields.name: tls.ciphers
fields.description: Specify TLS ciphers up to TLSv1.2.

fields.name: tls.crt_file
fields.description: Absolute path to Certificate file.

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Set TLS debug level. Accepts 0 (No debug), 1(Error), 2 (State change), 3 (Informational) and 4 (Verbose).

fields.name: tls.key_file
fields.description: Absolute path to private Key file.

fields.name: tls.key_passwd
fields.description: Optional password for tls.key_file.

fields.name: tls.max_version
fields.description: Specify the maximum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.min_version
fields.description: Specify the minimum version of TLS.

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: Force certificate validation.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: Enable or disable to verify hostname.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Hostname to be used for TLS SNI extension.

fields.name: tls.windows.certstore_name
fields.description: Sets the certstore name on an output (Windows)

fields.name: tls.windows.use_enterprise_store
fields.description: Sets whether using enterprise certstore or not on an output (Windows)

fields.name: traces_uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target OTel endpoint.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Use the OpenObserve output plugin to ingest logs into OpenTelemetry.
